exclusion_detail: The lead is the In(III) chlorin-e6 / arylaminoquinazoline conjugate (a metal complex of a large tetrapyrrole macrocycle, built from natural-source chlorin e6 derivatives); metal complexes and organometallic/inorganic compounds are out of scope.

lead.label: 16 (In-2)
lead.why: Abstract: 'the In-containing conjugate effectively inhibited tumor cell proliferation at nanomolar concentrations'; text calls 16 (In-2) 'the most promising conjugate' used for in vivo PDT.

notes: All conjugates are Zn/In/Pd chlorin-e6 metallocomplexes; chlorin e6 itself is derived from a natural source (chlorophyll).
